newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian RTS slims index, lists Uralsvyazinform.
newsitem.headline: Russian RTS slims index, lists Uralsvyazinform.

text.p: Russian oil company Varyoganneftegaz has been taken off the Russian Trading System (RTS) index, which now has 22 shares, a spokesman for NAUFOR brokers association said on Tuesday.
NAUFOR also announced it had listed Ural area regional telephone company Uralsvyazinform on the RTS. It was not included on the index of leading shares, however.
It had risen to $0.045 on Tuesday at 0840 GMT from $0.043 on Monday.
NAUFOR changed the index after a problem with quotations of Varyoganneftegaz, a Siberian oil producer, caused the index to jump about 25 percent on April 2, the spokesman said.
Varyoganneftegaz shares, which are still listed on the RTS, had not traded on Tuesday but had a spread of $1.010/$3.800. They last traded on February 28 for $4.000.
